title: Yummy Korean Chicken KFC Fried Chicken
description: Crunchy, jammy fried chicken with a tomato ketchup glaze that satisfies midnight cravings.
instructions: Cut the chicken into katsuramuki cut strips and pat dry with paper towels.
Whisk the buttermilk with 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper, then soak the chicken for 10 minutes.
In a shallow bowl mix cornstarch, flour, and the Korean spice mix; dip each piece in the buttermilk, then dredge in the flour mixture, tapping off excess.
Heat the comal over medium heat and add sesame oil until shimmering.
Lay the coated chicken on the comal, cooking 4 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
In a separate bowl combine the tomato ketchup and honey; brush the glaze over the chicken during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the chicken from the comal, let rest 3 minutes, then sprinkle with chopped scallions.
Serve hot as a satisfying midnight snack.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
